name: Provision of removable trench cover
handbook: Code of Practice on Sewerage and Sanitary Works
editionNote: This rule card cites the 2nd Edition (Jan 2019) while the other Annex A rules cite the 3rd Edition (March 2025). Possible sign this rule wasn't updated in the 3rd Edition, or the card is stale -- flagged for the reviewer rather than assumed either way.
section: Annex A - Requirements for Construction of RC Trench
sourceFile: Capability Testing Pack/Annex A - The rules/SSW Annex A (c).docx
description: Access into the trench shall be from the top of the trench. The trench shall be covered with removable slabs or other hard covers with lifting feature.

interpretation.targetElement: RC Trench specifically -- see elementType gate below

checkedProperties.elementType: string, must read as 'RC Trench' (case-insensitive) for the rule to apply at all

interpretation.verdictLogic: NEEDS_REVIEW if elementType is missing or is not 'RC Trench' -- this rule's text and title are specific to trenches, and applying it to a different element type is an assumption, not a read. Otherwise: COMPLIANT only if coverPresent AND coverRemovable AND coverHasLiftingFeature; any single failure is NON_COMPLIANT.

elementTypeGateDecision: Drawing 1 never shows an element explicitly labelled 'RC Trench' with cover details -- only 'RC Sump' elements with a removable M/S grating cover. Drawing 2 does have a real 'RC Trench' element ('NEW 750MM WIDE RC TRENCH OVER EXTG MINOR SEWER LINE TO PE'S DETAIL', found via DXF search), but its cover is not described anywhere on that drawing either -- see docs/rules/annex-a-c-trench-cover.md, 'Reading it off drawing 2'. Considered treating RC Sump as equivalent to RC Trench for this rule (same top-access, removable-cover logic), but decided against it: the three Annex A rules (a/b/c) together form one coherent set specifically about RC Trench construction, so 'trench' is likely an intentionally specific term, not interchangeable with 'sump' -- a trench protects a running pipe over a length, a sump is a compact collection point, and each may have different construction standards we don't have visibility into (e.g. a trench cover might need to bear vehicle loads a sump cover doesn't). Silently substituting one for the other risks a false-positive compliance verdict. Chose to gate on elementType and return NEEDS_REVIEW for anything not explicitly 'RC Trench', per the brief's own guidance to flag uncertainty rather than guess.

sampleScenarios.description: Minor sewer is provided with trench and removable cover on top, with lifting feature.
sampleScenarios.expectedMessage: Trench cover is provided. Trench cover is removable with lifting feature.

sampleScenarios.description: The trench cover is not removable with lifting feature.
sampleScenarios.expectedMessage: Trench cover is not removable with lifting feature.

matchedPlanElement.note: Two 'RC Sump w/ removable M/S grating cover' elements found on the plan. Per the elementTypeGateDecision above, these are NOT adjudicated as RC Trench covers -- they resolve to NEEDS_REVIEW.
